task.title: Configure your Java build tool to use the Lightwell Network repository
task.shortdesc: Configure your Java build tool to resolve dependencies through the Lightwell Network repository by adding the repository to your existing build configuration.

ul.li: You have an active Lightwell Network membership.
You have created a Lightwell Network service account. For more information, see
You have chosen the repository tier that matches your environment. For more information, see .

You have one of the following Java build tools configured:
Apache Maven
Gradle

context.p: Select the configuration method that matches your build tool.

cmd.b: If you are using Apache Maven:

substep.cmd: Add one of the following blocks inside your existing <profiles> section, and add the corresponding <activeProfile> entry inside your existing <activeProfiles> section. If your settings.xml file does not have these sections, add the entire block:

Add a <server>block inside the <servers> section of your settings.xml file to configure authentication. The <id> must match the repository <id> in your profile. If your settings.xml file does not have a <servers> section, add one.

info.p: <service_account_username>: Specifies your registry service account username in the format XXXXXXX|service-account-name
<service_account_token>: Specifies your registry service account token.

info.note: To switch to the other repository tier, replace the block with the one for the other tier.

substep.cmd: Add the following repositories block. Ensure the Lightwell Network repository is placed above mavenCentral() to prioritize patched versions:

info.p: <service_account_username>: Specifies your registry service account username in the format XXXXXXX|service-account-name.
<service_account_token>: Specifies your registry service account token
To use the validated repository instead, replace remediated with validated in the URL.

substep.cmd: Add your service account credentials to your ~/.gradle/gradle.properties file.

note.p: Do not store credentials directly in your build.gradle file. Do not commit credentials to version control. Store them securely, for example, in your ~/.gradle/gradle.properties file.

ol.li:
Run a build to confirm that dependencies resolve through the Lightwell Network repository:
For maven, run the following command: $ mvn dependency:resolve
For Gradle, run the following command: $ gradle dependencies
Verify that the build output shows artifacts resolving from the Lightwell Network repository URL.

If you are using the Remediated or Predisclosure repository, add a remediated dependency to your project and verify that the resolved artifact includes the .rhlw-0000X or .rhlw-0000X-nXXXX version suffix, for example, 5.3.17.rhlw-00001 or 5.3.17.rhlw-00001-n0001.
